title: feat(types,runner)!: retire the app node's `actions` array, `AppAction` and `AppActionSchema` (objectui#7469)
body:
Fixes #7469
Clause-②: yes

This PR carries out the maintainer's ruling C on objectui#7469 (recorded in comment `5828532177`). The maintainer chose 「C 退役 actions[] (Recommended)」: "one channel, one contract". App-level actions are `navigation` items of `type: 'action'`. The free-form `actions` array on the app node, `AppAction`, `AppActionSchema` and the runner's rendering of them are retired.

The work was done by the `domain:spec#1` dispatch under claim `5852900400`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014fWVhLzhxR8qrFsJ5o8TYW`.

## What changed

**`@object-ui/types` (contract face).**
- `AppComponentSchema.actions` is now `actions?: never` on the TS face and `retirementTombstone(APP_ACTIONS_REFUSAL)` on the zod mirror. An authored array is refused with ONE `invalid_type` issue at `actions`. The message names the remedy in the spec's own spelling: `navigation: [{ id, type: 'action', label, actionDef: { actionName } }]`.
- `AppAction` (TS) and `AppActionSchema` (zod) are deleted, together with their exports from `.` and `./zod`. The unexported `AppActionSchemaType` is deleted too.
- `AppMenuItem` / `MenuItemSchema` stay, because the legacy `menu` still reads them (H3). The objectui#7719 `shortcut` refusal on them is unchanged in behaviour. Its guidance text and docblock named `AppAction.items` / `AppAction.shortcut`, and this change would have made that text false, so it now names the `menu` item instead.

**`@object-ui/runner`.** `LayoutRenderer` no longer reads the app's `actions`. The `'button'` arm, the `'user'` avatar-menu arm with its items, and the Bell's `actions` gate are gone. The chrome now has one rule: the Bell is always drawn, which is what an app with no `'button'` action got before. The now-unused dropdown and avatar imports are removed.

**Docs.**
- `content/docs/core/app-schema.mdx` "Global Actions" is rewritten to teach a `navigation` item of `type: 'action'`. The example is spec-valid. The section says the console sidebar dispatches the item by action name and that the runner renders no `navigation` items.
- Both `actions:` examples on that page are removed, along with the "keyboard shortcuts" best practice (that key retired with `AppAction`).
- `content/docs/guide/schema-overview.md` loses its two `actions` examples and the user-menu bullet.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/7469-app-actions-retired.md` declares `minor` for `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/runner`. The runner is published (`"private": false`) and is in the fixed group. There is no `major`.

## Mechanism hypotheses, measured

- **H1** was confirmed on BASE `01700dcd7` (the declarations and the three runner arms were where the dispatch said), and it was re-read before editing.
- **H2**: `AppComponentSchema` extends `.passthrough()` `BaseSchema`, so a deleted member would be KEPT in silence. The tombstone route follows from that. Block (d) of the new pin reads it: `AppMirror.omit({ actions: true })` parses the array green and keeps it.
- **H3**: `AppMenuItem` has another reader (`AppComponentSchema.menu`, `menuItemToNavigationItem`, the runner's sidebar), so it stays. No menu-item type was used only by `AppAction`.
- **H4**: the runner's `LayoutRenderer.appActionItems-6854.test.tsx` was retired with the arms. The new rule is pinned in `LayoutRenderer.chrome-7469.test.tsx`.
- **H5**: in objectstack `origin/main` `e2c4e12`, 0 of the 4 app-bearing files that carry `navigation:` write `actions:`. The control is that the same `actions: [` matcher does hit one file under `examples/`. In objectui, the only `actions:` on an app node were two docs pages, the runner pin and one types fixture. All are removed or re-pointed; the new retirement pin keeps one on purpose, under `@ts-expect-error`.
- **H6**: objectstack `origin/main` `e2c4e12` `AppSchema` is a `strictObject` whose body has no `actions` (0 hits; the control `navigation` has 26). On the installed spec 17.4.0, `AppSchema.safeParse` of an app with `actions` gives `unrecognized_keys` `[actions]`, and the same app with a `navigation` action item parses green. Pin block (c) covers this. There is no spec change.

## Verification (final head `52e5d79278`, merge of `main` at `704e05b09`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/ packages/runner/` passed: 250 files, 5351 tests, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- The type-checks passed, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`, each against a freshly rebuilt dependency closure:
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (three programs);
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/runner type-check`;
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`.
- **Consumer direction (downstream)**: `@object-ui/app-shell` was type-checked green. Its one file naming `AppComponentSchema` (`useNavigationSync.ts`) passed its test (1 file, 12 tests). The nav-action dispatch and layout suites also passed (`useNavActionDispatch.test.tsx` plus `layout/__tests__/`: 36 files, 250 tests).
  - The census found no importer of `AppAction` / `AppActionSchema` outside `packages/types`. The census test asserts this.
  - The full app-shell vitest run is left to CI.
- **Cross-package reverse check**: a temporary runner test that authors `actions` on an `AppComponentSchema` literal failed `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` with TS2322 ("not assignable to type 'undefined'"). That proves the runner compiles against the rebuilt `.d.ts`. The file was removed afterwards and the tree was clean.
- **Ablation** (committed first, reverted to the BASE blobs verified by `git hash-object`, restored from `HEAD`, and `git diff HEAD` read empty after each leg):
  - Types leg: the new pin went 6 failed / 8 passed. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` raised TS2578 twice (on the `AppAction` import directive and the `actions` directive) and TS2344 on the `Equal` assertion.
  - Runner leg: the chrome pin went 4 failed / 2 passed, and both controls stayed green.
- **Gates**, each exit 0 on `52e5d79278`:
  - Changesets: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed` and `check-changeset-overwrite`. The report-only gates `check:changeset-claims` and `check:pending-changeset-literals` ran too.
  - Tree-wide checks: `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check-type-check-coverage` and `check:prompt-keys`.
  - Docs: `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-snippets` (676 of 676 blocks), `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-expression-carriage`, `check-doc-links` and `check:doc-example-readers`.
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 18 diff paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- **ESLint** `--no-inline-config` on the 13 touched TS/TSX/MJS files (the file count is read from `--format json`): 4 errors and 9 warnings. The per-file, per-rule tally is identical to the same files at the merge base, so there are 0 differences. The 4 errors are pre-existing sites that carry inline disables. The config is not type-aware (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
- **NOT MEASURED: Spec Main Shape Gate.** Reason: it needs a spec tarball built from objectstack `main` and injected into the virtual store, which is CI's job on this PR. The one coordinate this diff moves on a spec-derived type is `actions`, and objectstack `main` `e2c4e12` does not declare it (H6), so the gate compiles this change the same way against `main` as against the pin.

## Acceptance notes

- **Surface beyond the claim's file list, needed by the retirement.** These edits are forced by deleting the types:
  - `app-action-onclick-refusal-6854.test.ts` is deleted. It pinned `AppActionSchema.onClick` only.
  - `app-menu-item-shortcut-refusal-7719.test.ts` is re-pointed. Its control on `AppAction.shortcut` is dropped, its message assertion now names `AppMenuItem`, and its authoring-position block runs through `AppComponentSchema.menu`.
  - `handler-keys-string-any-mirrors-7344.test.ts` is updated:
    - the RETIRED ledger goes from 4 to 3 sites (9 in total). The whole schema left, so no key was reclassified in place.
    - the objectui#7721 reader census now asserts ZERO readers, with the former reader as the positive control.
    - the plain-`z.object` deletion probe went with its only instance. The same strip is still measured on `MenuItemSchema` in the 7719 pin.
  - `component-docs-retired-handler-keys-7340.test.ts` records the census move from 27 to 26, and `app.ts` leaves it.
  - `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` loses only this pair's rows and imports. `EXPECTED_MIRROR_PAIRS` goes from 160 to 159, per its own instruction.
  - `phase2-schemas.test.ts` swaps its `actions` fixture for a `navigation` action item.
  - `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs` gets one `DOC_TYPE_EXEMPTIONS` entry, `action` on `core/app-schema.mdx`, because it is a NavigationItem kind and not a node. The script's 18 suites passed: 689 tests, exit 0.
- **Pending changesets that now describe `AppAction` as it was.** `check:changeset-claims` (report-only) lists `.changeset/7760-lazy-mirror-input-type-args.md`, which names the deleted 6854 test file. The 6854, 7344, 7719 and 7721 entries also describe `AppAction`. They were not edited, because `check-changeset-overwrite` guards other cards' changesets. This PR's changeset says in its own body that they predate the retirement.
- **Runner scope after the ruling.** The standalone runner draws the legacy `menu` only and renders no `navigation` item. After this change it has no way to show app-level actions. That is the ruling's stated cost (「独立运行器失去头部按钮和用户菜单」), and the docs say it in plain words.
- **Observation, not filed.** The runner's sidebar `NavItem` reads a `menu` item's `path`, `label`, `icon` and `children`. It does not read the declared `AppMenuItem.href` ("External Link"). app-shell honours `href` through `menuItemToNavigationItem`. This comes from reading the source only; no producer or public entry point was measured. Carrier: none.
- The stale branch `claude/issue-7469-app-shell-global-actions` was not touched.
